description: This file defines the DatabaseBackend class for flood control in Drupal, implementing methods for registering events, clearing events, checking permissions, and managing the flood table schema.

classes.name: DatabaseBackend
classes.description: Implements flood control backend using a database table, providing methods for event registration, clearance, permission checks, and schema management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DatabaseBackend with database connection, request stack, and time service.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a flood event, inserting it into the database, with retry if the table does not exist.

methods.name: doInsert
methods.description: Inserts a flood event record into the database table.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears flood events for a given name and optional identifier.

methods.name: clearByPrefix
methods.description: Clears flood events matching a prefix pattern.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if an action is allowed based on flood threshold within a time window.

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Removes expired flood events from the database.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Ensures the flood table exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: catchException
methods.description: Handles exceptions, propagating if the table exists and the error is not related to table creation.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for the flood control database table.
